Selected equipment: Unarmed Pressen strikes with Sensen gauntlet; no hand-held sword or gun.

Read each physical row as TWO four-pose sequences, columns1–4 then columns5–8. Each sequence contains four different native poses, in this exact twelve-sequence order:
ROW1 left INTRO: ready equipment, settle feet, take stance. ROW1 right OUTRO: relax, lower equipment, turn slightly to leave while still readable side-on.
ROW2 left FIRST-ROUND VICTORY: restrained in-character acknowledgement and ready for next round. ROW2 right FIRST-ROUND DEFEAT: tired uninjured bend or kneel, whole body and equipment visible, no falling outside cell.

ROW4 right SUPER: One compact physical selected-body or selected-weapon strike and recovery; no detached blade wave or victim.; precisely four different poses ordered PREPARE / ANTICIPATE / RELEASE / RECOVER. Keep chosen equipment complete, attached to the correct hands or real built-in mount.
ROW5 left BASIC IDLE: four subtle but distinct whole-body breathing/balance poses. ROW5 right BASIC RUN: four distinctly different alternating-limb movement poses facing right, selected equipment controlled.
ROW6 left BASIC ACTION: One compact physical selected-body or selected-weapon strike and recovery; no detached blade wave or victim.; four different poses PREPARE / ANTICIPATE / RELEASE / RECOVER, discharge or contact THIRD, no emission before or after. ROW6 right UNINJURED HIT REACTION: four balanced recoil/recovery poses, complete body, no blood or wounds.




This is newly drawn adaptation of the stated source version, not copied official game frames. All48 complete native drawings must be distinct. Transparent pixels surround each individual sprite on all sides.
